title: Stand up the shared stack: one backend deployed in shared tenancy mode, in its own AWS account
description:
Outcome: Deploy the same Papyrus backend artefact once with tenancy mode "shared" (owner decision 2 recommends its own AWS account, e.g. papyrus-shared, rather than papyrus-production where every dedicated site and Prospectus live: separate Lambda concurrency quota, blast radius and a clean cost line). Uses the bootstrap stage (PAPYRUS_BOOTSTRAP_STAGE=1, OPTIONAL_MODEL_GROUPS) for the first create, which keeps under CloudFormation's 2,500-resource limit. No site files are bundled into content-actions (python-bundle siteFiles empty); configuration comes from the site store. A staging copy of the shared stack is where every release lands first (PPY-1192d3).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/site-backend.ts, amplify/site-backend-config.ts (tenancy mode), amplify/data/schema.ts (OPTIONAL_MODEL_GROUPS, bootstrap), amplify/functions/content-actions/resource.ts (setSiteFilesForContentActionsBundle), infra/amplify-app-shell (a shell for the shared newsroom app), docs/site-hosting.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/shared-stack-bootstrap.feature):
Scenario: The shared stack starts empty and serves no site
    Given a fresh shared stack
    When any host is requested
    Then the edge answers 404 and the API holds no tenant rows

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-7dc463. Blocks PPY-99e309, PPY-130eb2, PPY-49d059, PPY-f7ce77, PPY-7438d9. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-fea16f.

Testing: Synth tests for tenancy mode; a sandbox deploy; Amplify job log read before any retry (AGENTS.md rule).
Rollout: Staging first, then production of the shared stack. Needs Ryan's approval for the new account and the deploy (no production AWS action from planning).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a new account means new SSO, SES, Google OAuth client and DNS delegation steps. Mitigation: a runbook listing each, done once in staging first.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: changes: a new deployment with shared-mode rules.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
